description: Modern ATAK's FRS app draws its Header panel handle as one letter per line, so the English dictionary cannot translate the French word ENTETE. The handle uses the letters of HEADER instead. The default TOC post callsign changes from the Athena brand OVERWATCH to ZERO. The finds are ASCII-only because the original letter list contains an accented character.

ops.replace: private _whole = _plain call comspec_atak_native_fnc_tr; if (_whole isNotEqualTo _plain) then { _cut = _whole find ": "; if (_cut > 0 && {_cut <= 28}) then { _title = _whole select [0, _cut]; _plain = _whole select [_cut + 2]; } else { _plain = _whole; }; } else { if (_cut > 0 && {_cut <= 28}) then { _title = _plain select [0, _cut]; _plain = _plain select [_cut + 3]; }; _plain = _plain call comspec_atak_native_fnc_tr; }; _title = _title call comspec_atak_native_fnc_tr;
